title: Principal Design Engineer
description: We are looking for a Principal Design Engineer to lead our core design systems. You will be responsible for defining the visual language of the KaaMe ecosystem, ensuring a consistent and premium experience across all platforms. You will work closely with front-end engineers to implement state-of-the-art UI components using Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS.

title: Head of Strategic Growth
description: AlphaFoundry is seeking a strategic leader to drive our global expansion. As the Head of Strategic Growth, you will identify new market opportunities, lead partnership negotiations, and execute high-impact growth campaigns. You must have a track record of scaling Series B+ startups and a deep understanding of B2B networking dynamics.

title: Lead Security Researcher
description: Join our elite security team as a Lead Security Researcher. You will perform deep-dive vulnerability research, develop zero-day exploits (for defensive purposes), and lead our internal red-teaming exercises. Experience with low-level systems, cryptography, and cloud security architectures is essential.

title: Staff Product Manager
description: QuantHouse is building the future of algorithmic trading infrastructure. We need a Staff PM to own our low-latency data platforms. You will work with HFT firms to define requirements and lead a team of high-caliber engineers to deliver world-class products.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description: NovaStream is the leading platform for immersive live streaming. We are scaling our edge delivery network and need a Fullstack maestro to build high-performance dashboards and interactive creator tools. If you love Next.js, Rust, and WebRTC, join us.

title: VP of Design
description: EtherLabs is redefining how humans interact with spatial computing. As VP of Design, you will oversee our entire creative direction, from hardware interface to XR software ecosystems. You will mentor a global team of multidisciplinary designers.

title: Blockchain Architect
description: DeFi Bridge is building the world's most secure cross-chain liquidity protocol. We need a Blockchain Architect to design our next-gen consensus mechanisms and bridge security layers. Deep knowledge of Solidity, Move, or Rust is mandatory.

title: ML Research Scientist
description: AetherIA is fine-tuning the next generation of autonomous agents. We are looking for researchers focused on RLHF and sparse-model optimization. You will publish at NIPS/ICML and ship production-grade models that power the KaaMe AI ecosystem.
